## Checklist

- [ ] The tool is not already listed — I searched the README for both its **name** and its **domain**.
- [ ] The link is the product's **official website**, in canonical HTTPS form, with no tracking parameters.
- [ ] The link is not an affiliate or referral link.
- [ ] The description is my own writing, one sentence, 8–25 words, with no superlatives or vendor tagline copy.
- [ ] The entry is in the **correct category**, and in only one category.
- [ ] The entry is in the right **alphabetical position** within that category.
- [ ] Pricing uses only `Free`, `Freemium`, `Paid`, `Open Source`, `Free Trial` (at most two).
- [ ] Platform labels are from the allowed set, and I am confident about each one I used.
- [ ] No unrelated files are touched, and no unrelated entries were reordered or reformatted.
- [ ] The Markdown renders correctly in GitHub's preview tab.
